name: Nikaidou Yuu
source:
She is a sensible wife and wise mother figure who is smart enough to play the adult game. She is a good mother and teacher, although she sometimes has a strong sense of self. She is trusted by the school and students, both male and female.
She and Sae are sisters, but they are very different in age.
